visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a young man and woman in an outdoor park with green grass and city buildings in the background. The man wears a black t-shirt and the woman a grey tank top. They are smiling and talking directly to the camera, looking energetic and happy. (2) The scene shifts to the woman turning around and starting to run away across the vast green lawn. The man stays near the camera, holding up his hand and folding fingers one by one to count down from five to one, smiling mischievously at the lens. (3) The camera angle follows the man as he starts running rapidly towards the woman. The background of tall urban buildings and trees blurred slightly due to the fast movement. The woman is seen running in the distance ahead of him on the grass. (4) The man catches up to the woman and reaches out his hand to grab her arm. She laughs and slows down, showing a playful reaction as she is "caught". The lighting is bright natural daylight, highlighting their expressions and the lush green field. (5) The woman leans forward, hands on her knees, panting heavily from the sprint. Her face is flushed, and she looks exhausted but amused. The man stands beside her, looking triumphant. Buildings and park visitors are visible as blurry figures in the distant background. (6) In a medium shot, the man is now carrying the woman on his back in a piggyback ride. Both are laughing and talking. The woman's arms are wrapped around his neck, and they move slowly across the field. The camera moves with them, maintaining a steady eye-level shot. (7) They stop moving, and the man leans down as they continue their playful argument. The woman tries to slide off his back but he holds on briefly. They are both smiling, showing a close and affectionate relationship. The park environment remains sunny and calm. (8) The woman finally shouts something while gesturing with her arms and then runs off again. The man pumps his fist in the air, celebrating his "victory". The video ends with them both in a wide shot against the backdrop of the city park.
